purpose: Improve the 717-case Yb training density fit while retaining neighbor-like d/f shell extents and independently integrable free-ion densities.
method: Two coordinate-descent sweeps, 8 evaluations per free parameter, multiplicative bounds 0.9 to 1.1 relative to ion_g2; ion configuration gate retained.
frozen_positions: All of rows 6 and 11, plus (13,10) shell_resp(11,1); (6,6) remains 1.1392905882.
selection: Select by training score only. Validation may reject overfitting, never select. Do not replace embedded ion_g2 defaults before independent gates pass.
acceptance: Training score below 0.019426166410 with exactly the same 717-case objective and basis.
Free-ion gate violation zero and electron traces 24/22/21 within 1e-6.
Rows 6 and 11 and coordinate (13,10) byte-identical to ion_g2; AO shell radii unchanged within 1e-4 bohr at quadrature orders 32 and 64.
Independent NoSpherA2 counts within 1e-3 of 24/22/21 at orders 32 and 64, order-to-order counts within 1e-5.
Yb q0/q2/q3 total RMS radii no more than 1% above ion_g2, with the neighbor comparison reported explicitly.
Validation score no worse than ion_g2 after its uncertainty is considered; reject material regression.
